recognize_zh: 低倍下幾段骨髓切片主要由粉紅色、寬大相連的骨小樑組成，髓腔被擠壓到幾乎消失，只剩零星紫色細胞區；這種骨多髓少的低倍影像提示骨質硬化。
features: Fragmented cores composed predominantly of eosinophilic bone
Broad, anastomosing trabeculae with marked narrowing to near obliteration of intertrabecular marrow spaces
Only small, patchy residual foci of hematopoietic cells
One solid pale homogeneous fragment consistent with cortical bone or cartilage
describe_en: Low-power view of bone marrow core biopsy fragments shows that the specimen is composed predominantly of bone, with broad, anastomosing and widened trabeculae that nearly obliterate the intertrabecular marrow spaces. Residual hematopoietic tissue is scant and patchy, and one fragment consists of solid pale homogeneous tissue, likely cortical bone or cartilage. Cellular detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. The findings indicate marked osteosclerosis with reduced marrow space, supportive of osteopetrosis in the appropriate clinical and radiographic context.

ddx.vs: PMF osteosclerosis is accompanied by atypical megakaryocyte clusters and reticulin fibrosis in adults, rather than primary bone overgrowth in an infant.
Sclerotic metastases contain cohesive keratin-positive tumor cells between the new bone.
A tangential sample of normal cortex contains compact bone with Haversian canals but normal trabecular spacing elsewhere, whereas all fragments here show widened trabeculae.
